name: vhdl-simulation-synthesis-extenstion
description: ECNG 2007 Group 4 - Project 4A Open Tools Workflow (GHDL and Surfer)

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension runs GHDL and Surfer executables named by workspace settings, so it needs a trusted workspace.

p4a.toolManifestPath.description: Path to the Local EDA Tool Manifest v1 (JSON). Used to locate GHDL and Surfer when p4a.ghdlPath / p4a.surferPath are empty. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder. %VARIABLE% references are expanded.

p4a.ghdlPath.description: Optional override: full path to ghdl.exe. Empty = use the tool manifest entry, then 'ghdl' on PATH.

p4a.surferPath.description: Optional override: full path to surfer.exe. Empty = use the tool manifest entry, then 'surfer' on PATH.

p4a.sourceFiles.description: VHDL files passed to 'ghdl -a', in order, relative to the workspace folder.

p4a.testbenchEntity.description: Testbench entity elaborated with 'ghdl -e' and run with 'ghdl -r'.

p4a.waveformFile.description: VCD file written by 'ghdl -r --vcd=...' and opened in Surfer, relative to the workspace folder.
